organization: PARKS, The International Journal of Protected Areas and Conservation (IUCN WCPA)
why_relevant: the dedicated peer-reviewed venue for protected areas; a ground-visible route that does not require a personal network
notes: journal homepage states submissions closed until 1 May 2027 except two special volumes; check the current call before submitting. Editorial address published on the journal site is institutional, not used here as a personal contact.

organization: IUCN World Commission on Protected Areas (WCPA)
field: protected and conserved areas policy and science
why_relevant: over 3200 members in 140 countries; the relevant specialist community for a leakage or effectiveness claim, reached through an opt-in application rather than a purchased list
notes: membership is free and reviewed by a steering committee; use the public application route, not individual commissioners.

why_relevant: institutional route for routing a protected-area methods claim to the relevant programme without naming a person
notes: form is not confidential; do not send an unreleased claim you need protected.

organization: IUCN Green List of Protected and Conserved Areas
field: effective and equitable protected area management
why_relevant: the Green List is explicitly about effective management outcomes rather than area designated, which is the exact residual in this solution
notes: site states it is in beta; use the public get-involved route and expect a programme-level reply.

organization: Protected Planet (UNEP World Conservation Monitoring Centre)
field: protected area and OECM data, monitoring and reporting
public_contact_or_submission: public data platform and get-in-touch channel
why_relevant: the ground-adjacent venue: monthly updated coverage data and the Protected Planet Report; useful for locating a counterfactual and checking whether a coverage claim is the only evidence offered
notes: data submissions come from governments and organisations; no personal email used here. Coverage statistics are a frame-internal quantity for the verdict.

why_relevant: the main international membership society for conservation science; its journals and sections are where per-site effectiveness and displacement work is read
notes: use the public publications or society routes; no ranking by likely agreement and no personal emails.
